record.paper_title: Banach spaces and Ramsey Theory: some open problems
record.original_question: Let X be a reflexive Banach space with at most countably many equivalence classes of spreading models generated by normalized weakly null sequences; that is, |SP_w(X)/∼| ≤ ℵ_0. Does X contain a normalized weakly null sequence generating a spreading model equivalent to the standard unit vector basis of c_0 or of ℓ_p for some 1 ≤ p < ∞?

evidence.quote: Problem 5. (Countable spreading models problem – S. J. Dilworth, E. Odell and B. Sari [20]) Let X be a reflexive Banach space such that |SPw(X)/ ∼ | 6 ℵ0. Does there exist a normalized weakly null sequence in X generating a spreading model equivalent to the standard unit vector basis of c0 or ℓp for some 1 6 p < +∞?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be an infinite-dimensional real Banach space. Recall that a normalized sequence $(x_n)$ in $X$ is said to generate a spreading model $(e_n)$ on a Banach space $E$ with basis $(e_n)$ if for every $k \in \mathbb{N}$ and every $\varepsilon > 0$ there exists $N \in \mathbb{N}$ such that for all $N \le n_1 < n_2 < \cdots < n_k$ and all scalars $a_1,\dots,a_k$ with $|a_i| \le 1$,
$$\Big| \, \big\| \textstyle\sum_{i=1}^k a_i x_{n_i} \big\| - \big\| \textstyle\sum_{i=1}^k a_i e_i \big\| \, \Big| < \varepsilon.$$
Let $SP_w(X)$ denote the set of (isomorphism types of) spreading models generated by normalized weakly null sequences in $X$, and let $\sim$ denote the equivalence relation of being equivalent as basic sequences (i.e. $(e_n) \sim (f_n)$ iff there is a constant $C$ such that $C^{-1}\|\sum a_i e_i\| \le \|\sum a_i f_i\| \le C\|\sum a_i e_i\|$ for all finitely supported scalar sequences).

Suppose $X$ is reflexive and that $|SP_w(X)/{\sim}| \le \aleph_0$. Must there exist a normalized weakly null sequence in $X$ that generates a spreading model equivalent to the standard unit vector basis of $c_0$ or of $\ell_p$ for some $1 \le p < \infty$?
artifact.status_search_result: The "countable spreading models problem" of Dilworth, Odell, and Sari appears to remain open in full generality. Partial results are known: if both $SP_w(X)$ and $SP_w(Y^*)$ are countable for every infinite-dimensional subspace $Y$ of $X$, then every spreading model is equivalent to the unit vector basis of $c_0$ or $\ell_p$. The case $|SP_w(X)/{\sim}| = 1$ has also been partially treated. Recent (2024) work on related separation problems for $\ell_1$ spreading models continues to reference this question without resolving it.

status_evidence.title: On the Structure of the Spreading Models of a Banach Space
status_evidence.snippet: If SPw(X) is countable and SPw(Y*) is countable for all infinite-dimensional subspaces Y of X, then every spreading model is equivalent to the unit vector basis of c0 or ℓp.
status_evidence.claim: Only a conditional partial result is established; the unconditional countable spreading models problem is left open.

status_evidence.title: On the complete separation of unique ℓ1 spreading models and the Lebesgue property of Banach spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on unique ℓ1 spreading models continues to discuss the structural problems posed by Dilworth, Odell, and Sari.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is still discussed as open in current literature.
